# Craig Shimmon

> Craig Shimmon is a digital skills coach and trainer at Primary Goal, helping people in education feel more confident with technology. He is a drummer and musician, and his background is in audio: first as a recording engineer, then as a music technology lecturer. He describes himself as "a teacher at heart, a techie by habit and a drummer by choice."

Craig doesn't use social media much, so this site (https://shimmon.co.uk/) is the main place to find out about him. LinkedIn is the best way to contact him.

## About

- Name: Craig Shimmon
- Current role: Digital skills coach and trainer at Primary Goal, working with people in education
- Previous roles: Recording engineer; music technology lecturer
- Music: Drummer and musician; plays whenever he can
- Interests: Sound, circuits and code; 3D printing; amateur radio (call sign M9XCN); writing
- Location context: UK (site is in British English)
